learning_outcomes.text: Interprets fundamental knowledge regarding one-dimensional flow of compressible fluid.
Interprets fundamental knowledge about steam turbines, fans, and compressors and their design.
Draws velocity triangles at the inlet and outlet sections of a turbomachine and performs its design.
Performs dimensioning using concepts and basic calculation relations for the design of steam turbines, fans, and compressors.
Dimensions turbo compressor systems used in internal combustion engines.

syllabus_topics: Nozzles, flow and dimensioning in nozzles.
assessment_rules: The overall grade is composed of 60% in-term success and 40% final exam. In-term success is composed of a 40% midterm exam, 10% quiz, 10% homework, and 40% project/design.
